title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-05
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains for ranks 1–12, plus a GitHub Search newly-active supplement with unavailable daily gain
ranking_explanation: The first 12 entries are ranked descending by stars-today values on the matching GitHub Trending daily page. A 13th, explicitly labeled newly-active supplement was found with GitHub Search for repos created 2026-11-03 through 2026-11-05; its daily Trending gain is unavailable. global_caveat: GitHub Trending daily star gains are point-in-time displayed values; API star totals and the Trending scrape can differ slightly. The newly-active supplement is not on the Trending page and has no comparable daily gain. Repository README claims were not independently benchmarked.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-11-05 01:38 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-11-04 through 2026-11-05. Ranking basis: Daily Trending star gains for ranks 1–12 plus a newly-active GitHub Search supplement; total stars and current commits corroborated via GitHub sources.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI-agent tooling dominates today: accessibility-based computer use leads, with semantic context, persistent memory, reusable workflows, and parallel-agent development also drawing strong attention. A newly created event-driven agent orchestrator adds an early high-star signal. Practical local infrastructure—from AWS emulation to CPU inference—joins standout scraping and creative-production utilities.

sections.title: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
sections.description: Computer-use CLI for AI agents; operates desktop apps through accessibility-tree references rather than screenshot/pixel matching.
sections.why_notable: Leads today with +2,470 stars and represents a concrete shift from screenshot-driven computer use to structured accessibility-tree interaction.

sections.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
sections.description: Builds a semantic context layer from enterprise metadata so agents can ground analytics in governed metrics, entities, relationships, and provenance.
sections.why_notable: Second by daily gain (+2,050); the repo frames reliable agentic analytics as a semantic context and provenance problem.

sections.title: D4Vinci/Scrapling
sections.description: Python web-scraping framework intended to scale from individual requests to full crawls.
sections.why_notable: Third by daily gain (+2,005), showing strong demand for practical web-data acquisition tooling.

sections.title: JiaFeiMiao-K-Cat/DiscImageStudio
sections.description: Cross-platform disc-image design and burning tool that converts artwork into visible CD/DVD/single-layer Blu-ray surface patterns.
sections.why_notable: Fourth by daily gain (+1,778), a high-momentum specialist utility outside the dominant agent-tool cluster.

sections.title: mattpocock/skills
sections.description: Composable engineering-focused agent skills, designed to be adapted and used across coding models.
sections.why_notable: +1,379 stars; its model-agnostic, composable engineering skills illustrate the packaging of development practice as reusable agent workflows.

sections.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
sections.description: Persistent memory for coding agents, capturing session activity, compressing it, and retrieving relevant context in later sessions.
sections.why_notable: +1,172 stars; persistent cross-session context is another major agent infrastructure signal.

sections.title: floci-io/floci
sections.description: Local AWS emulator for development, testing, and CI, designed to work with standard AWS SDKs and tooling.
sections.why_notable: +1,090 stars; local cloud emulation continues to attract attention as a reproducible developer/testing workflow.

sections.title: github/spec-kit
sections.description: Toolkit for spec-driven development and other structured coding-agent processes, with reusable processes, templates, and extensions.
sections.why_notable: +808 stars; a prominent formalization of spec-driven and process-driven coding-agent work.

sections.title: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
sections.description: Automates short-video creation from a topic or keyword, including script, media matching, subtitles, music, and rendering.
sections.why_notable: +617 stars; a full content-production workflow broadens the snapshot beyond coding agents.

sections.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
sections.description: Rust CLI for Git worktree management, including parallel AI-agent workflows.
sections.why_notable: +531 stars; worktrees are explicitly positioned for parallel AI-agent workflows.

sections.title: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
sections.description: Portable C99 inference engine; its README claims a 2.78T-parameter model can run on CPU with 8.24 GB peak RSS (not independently benchmarked here).
sections.why_notable: +351 stars; unusually ambitious CPU-only local inference claim, but performance and model-equivalence figures are repository claims rather than independently tested here.
sections.unique_caveat: README performance figures are repository claims and were not independently benchmarked.

sections.title: garrytan/gstack
sections.description: Role-based Claude Code workflows for product framing, architecture, review, QA, security, and release.
sections.why_notable: +290 stars; role-specialized agent workflows show a team/process metaphor gaining traction.

sections.title: KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop
sections.description: A newly created, self-hosted event-driven automation hub that routes scheduled or external events to CLI agents, pauses for human decisions when needed, then resumes work.
sections.why_notable: Created on 2026-11-03 and surfaced near the top of GitHub Search for repositories created through 2026-11-05; plugin-based, human-approval-aware agent orchestration is a strong newly active signal, but its daily gain is not directly comparable to Trending entries.
sections.unique_caveat: README lists macOS and Linux support; Windows is not yet available. Not present on the daily Trending view, so daily star gain is unavailable.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
Agent operating environments and reusable workflows: The leading signal is tooling around how agents act and work: accessibility-based desktop control, persistent memory, composable skills, structured specs, Git worktrees, role-based engineering workflows, and a newly created event-driven agent orchestrator. Supporting repositories: repo-01, repo-05, repo-06, repo-08, repo-10, repo-12, repo-13.
Grounded agent context and data acquisition: NVIDIA Auto Ontology focuses on governed semantic context for analytics agents, while Scrapling supplies the web-data acquisition layer; together they emphasize better inputs and traceable answers rather than only model capability. Supporting repositories: repo-02, repo-03.
Local and reproducible developer infrastructure: Floci emulates AWS locally, Worktrunk supports parallel worktrees, and kimi-k3-in-c explores CPU-only inference; each makes local execution or parallel development a core proposition. Supporting repositories: repo-07, repo-10, repo-11.
Purpose-built creative and media utilities: Disc Image Studio and MoneyPrinterTurbo show that specialized creative production tools also earn significant daily attention outside the coding-agent cluster. Supporting repositories: repo-04, repo-09.
Languages: Python (4), TypeScript (3), Rust (2), C (1), C# (1), Java (1), Shell (1).

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s strongest shared pattern is the engineering of agent workflows around context, tools, and repeatable process—not just model wrappers. The list is not exclusively AI: scraping, local cloud emulation, disc imaging, and automated video creation show meaningful demand for sharply scoped utilities as well.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary: GitHub Trending daily. Corroboration: REST repository and default-branch commits for 12 daily Trending entries; GitHub Search API checks for two leading repos. A created-date GitHub Search from 2026-11-03 through 2026-11-05 identified Agent Autoloop; the repository page confirmed creation date, current stars, default branch, and commit. Current repository READMEs were consulted. Daily Trending gains rank the first 12; Agent Autoloop is an explicitly labeled newly-active supplement with unavailable daily gain.
